items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Constitution rules are a machine-readable section of conventions.json (67 entries, one per rule), with a parser, drift test, generated doc and updated constitution/guide text. Architecture rules and profile pluggability are deferred on purpose, with reasons.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: CLI exits 2 on a missing or unreadable file, 1 on drift; entries with missing keys are reported, not raised.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Reads local files only; no network, no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 12 tests: parser units, each drift class on throwaway fixtures, hook registration, CLI, plus the real-repo drift and doc-sync checks.

items.name: Naming
items.note: constitution_register across lib, tool, test and doc; enforcement vocabulary is closed.
